      About this item

      • High Lumen Output & Eco-Friendly: Delivers up to 2000 lumens in AC mode, ensuring bright and energy-efficient lighting for your spaces.
      • 3-Step Dimming Feature: Adjustable brightness levels (100%, 50%, and 25%) with a simple switch, perfect for emergencies and energy saving.
      • Safety Specifications: Built for Indian conditions with wide voltage operations (100-440V), 4KV surge protection, and overcharge & deep discharge prevention.
      • Versatile Application: Ideal for use in malls, warehouses, restaurants, study rooms, corridors, and garages, blending functionality with durability.
      • Compact & Durable Design: Sleek dimensions of 160 mm height and 90 mm base, designed to fit seamlessly into any space.

      From the manufacturer

      High Lumens

      This rechargeable LED bulb delivers unmatched brightness with an output of 100 lumens per watt for optimal lighting.

      Energy Efficient

      Designed with energy efficiency and sustainability in mind, this emergency LED bulb is the perfect fit for all homes during power outages.

      3-Step Dimming

      This battery-operated LED bulb offers convenient brightness adjustment for different scenarios, adapting to your changing needs.

      Wide Voltage Range

      Operates seamlessly between 100-440V, ensuring you’re never left in the dark, no matter the condition.

      Surge Protection

      Keeps your device safe with 4KV surge resistance, offering peace of mind and reliability, ideal for places which have power fluctuations.

      Durability

      Built to prevent overcharge and deep discharge, ensuring your emergency LED bulb has a longer lifespan.

      About this Item

      • High Lumen Output & Eco-Friendly: Delivers up to 2000 lumens in AC mode, ensuring bright and energy-efficient lighting for your spaces.
      • 3-Step Dimming Feature: Adjustable brightness levels (100%, 50%, and 25%) with a simple switch, perfect for emergencies and energy saving.
      • Safety Specifications: Built for Indian conditions with wide voltage operations (100-440V), 4KV surge protection, and overcharge & deep discharge prevention.
      • Versatile Application: Ideal for use in malls, warehouses, restaurants, study rooms, corridors, and garages, blending functionality with durability.
      • Compact & Durable Design: Sleek dimensions of 160 mm height and 90 mm base, designed to fit seamlessly into any space.
